purpose: Declares how state is handled across a visit, for agents that need to know whether context persists.

statefulness.note: Every request is independent. No login, no server-side session, no personalised content. The same URL returns the same content to every visitor and every agent.

agent_guidance.observation_ids: An observation returns an observationId. Retain it to request a later diff. Observations are not chained to a session.
agent_guidance.rate_limit_scope: per source address, not per session

content_variation.note: No cloaking. Crawlers receive exactly what browsers receive.
